## Purpose

Standalone walkthrough of `_targets.R`'s `soil_water_raw` -> `soil_water_long`
steps, calling `2_preprocessing/R/functions_soil_water.R` and
`functions_management.R` directly. This is the data the DL nitrate-leaching
method (`3_analysis/01_no3_leaching_dl_method.qmd`) is built on.

```{r setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

source(here("2_preprocessing", "R", "functions_soil_water.R"))
source(here("2_preprocessing", "R", "functions_management.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "utils.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "plot_theme.R"))
```

## Step 1: Read the suction-cup workbook

```{r read}
soil_water_raw <- load_soil_water_xlsx(
  here("1_input_data", "soil_water", "VALUE4FARM_SOIL_WATER_DATA.xlsx")
)
soil_water_raw |> glimpse()
```

## Step 2: Detect the measurement window

```{r window}
soil_water_window <- soil_water_measurement_window(soil_water_raw)
soil_water_window
```

## Step 3: Which crop occupied each strip during this window?

Reuses the crop calendar built in `01_field_management.qmd`
(`4_outputs/data/field_management/crop_calendar.csv`) -- re-run that
document first if it hasn't been generated yet.

```{r strip-crop-lookup}
crop_calendar <- load_crop_calendar(
  here("4_outputs", "data", "field_management", "crop_calendar.csv")
)
strip_crop_lookup_tbl <- lookup_strip_crop(
  crop_calendar, soil_water_window["start"], soil_water_window["end"]
)
strip_crop_lookup_tbl
```

## Step 4: Clean and reshape to long format

```{r clean-reshape}
soil_water_clean <- clean_soil_water(soil_water_raw, strip_crop_lookup_tbl)
soil_water_long   <- reshape_soil_water_long(soil_water_clean)
soil_water_long |> glimpse()
```

## Step 5: Data completeness (EDA)

Proportion of NA (not reported by the lab) and UD (below detection limit,
substituted with DL/2) observations, by crop -- the other EDA figure the
original `SOIL_WATER.Rmd` had but this pipeline never ported until now.

```{r na-ud-crop}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
plot_na_ud_proportions(soil_water_long, group_var = "crop")
```

```{r na-ud-plot}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5
plot_na_ud_proportions(soil_water_long, group_var = "plot_no")
```

## Next step

`3_analysis/01_no3_leaching_dl_method.qmd` combines this `soil_water_long`
with Daisy drainage output to compute NO3-N leaching via the Drainage-Linear
method.
